app.title: KADATH
app.description: Evolutionary multi-agent runtime that breeds, evaluates, and improves autonomous agents across reproducible epochs to converge on optimization of a goal. - i3T4AN/KADATH
app.compose_content:
services:
  control:
    build: .
    profiles:
    - control
    environment:
      KADATH_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://kadath:${KADATH_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/kadath
      KADATH_SEED_DIR: /app/seed/smolagents
      KADATH_SEARXNG_URL: http://searxng:8080
      KADATH_LITELLM_URL: http://litellm:4000
      KADATH_MODEL: kadath-default
      KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL: ${KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL:?set KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL}
      KADATH_MODEL_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY: ${KADATH_MODEL_GLOBAL_CONCURRENCY:-64}
      KADATH_GRADER_CHUNK_TOKENS: ${KADATH_GRADER_CHUNK_TOKENS:-12000}
      KADATH_WORKER_GLOBAL_LIMIT: ${KADATH_WORKER_GLOBAL_LIMIT:-500}
      LITELLM_API_BASE: http://litellm:4000
      LITELLM_API_KEY: ${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY:?set LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}
      LITELLM_MASTER_KEY: ${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY:?set LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}
      KADATH_PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_URL: http://playwright-mcp:8931/mcp
      KADATH_BROWSER_IMAGE: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/mcp:latest
      KADATH_BROWSER_FLEET: ${KADATH_BROWSER_FLEET:-1}
      KADATH_GRADER_CONNECTOR_LEDGER_URL: ${KADATH_GRADER_CONNECTOR_LEDGER_URL:-}
      KADATH_GRADER_CONNECTOR_LEDGER_TOKEN: ${KADATH_GRADER_CONNECTOR_LEDGER_TOKEN:-}
      KADATH_IN_CONTAINER: '1'
      KADATH_CONTAINER_RUN_ROOT: /app/.kadath/runs
      KADATH_HOST_RUN_ROOT: ${PWD}/.kadath/runs
      KADATH_OBJECT_STORE_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      KADATH_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      KADATH_S3_BUCKET: kadath
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${KADATH_MINIO_USER:?set KADATH_MINIO_USER}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${KADATH_MINIO_PASSWORD:?set KADATH_MINIO_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
    - ./.kadath:/app/.kadath
    - ${KADATH_DOCKER_SOCKET:-/var/run/docker.sock}:/var/run/docker.sock
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
      litellm:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
    - control-plane
    - agent
  organism-worker:
    image: kadath-organism:latest
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: worker.Dockerfile
    profiles:
    - worker
    environment:
      KADATH_MODEL: kadath-default
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    networks:
    - agent
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: kadath
      POSTGRES_USER: kadath
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${KADATH_POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?set KADATH_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
    - kadath-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    - ./deploy/postgres/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/001-kadath.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U kadath -d kadath
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
    networks:
    - control-plane
  searxng:
    image: searxng/searxng:latest
    environment:
      BASE_URL: http://localhost:8080/
      SEARXNG_SECRET_KEY: ${SEARXNG_SECRET_KEY:?set SEARXNG_SECRET_KEY}
    volumes:
    - ./deploy/searxng:/etc/searxng:ro
    networks:
    - agent
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${KADATH_MINIO_USER:?set KADATH_MINIO_USER}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${KADATH_MINIO_PASSWORD:?set KADATH_MINIO_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
    - kadath-minio:/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - mc
      - ready
      - local
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
    networks:
    - control-plane
  litellm:
    image: ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:main-latest
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    command:
    - python -c 'import os,pathlib; source=pathlib.Path("/app/config.template.yaml").read_text();
      pathlib.Path("/tmp/kadath-litellm.yaml").write_text(source.replace("__KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL__",
      os.environ["KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL"]))' && exec litellm --config /tmp/kadath-litellm.yaml
      --port 4000
    environment:
      LITELLM_MASTER_KEY: ${LITELLM_MASTER_KEY:?set LITELLM_MASTER_KEY}
      KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL: ${KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL:?set KADATH_UPSTREAM_MODEL}
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
    volumes:
    - ./deploy/litellm/config.yaml:/app/config.template.yaml:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:4000/health/liveliness',
        timeout=5)
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
    networks:
    - control-plane
    - provider-egress
  playwright-mcp:
    image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/mcp:latest
    entrypoint:
    - node
    - /app/cli.js
    command:
    - --headless
    - --browser
    - chromium
    - --no-sandbox
    - --isolated
    - --allowed-hosts=playwright-mcp,control,organism-worker
    - --output-dir
    - /artifacts
    - --output-max-size
    - '1073741824'
    - --save-session
    - --port
    - '8931'
    - --host
    - 0.0.0.0
    profiles:
    - browser
    init: true
    shm_size: 1gb
    volumes:
    - ./.kadath/browser-artifacts:/artifacts
    networks:
    - agent
volumes:
  kadath-postgres: null
  kadath-minio: null
networks:
  control-plane:
    internal: true
  agent:
    name: kadath-agent
  provider-egress: null

app.title: Conformiti
app.description: A GRC Compliance tool for SaaS products to manage the entire lifecycle of security audits. - dboudreau00/Conformiti
app.compose_content:
x-backend-env:
  DJANGO_DEBUG: ${CONFORMITI_DEBUG:-false}
  DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_SECRET_KEY:-}
  DJANGO_SECRET_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_secret_key
  DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-}
  DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_field_encryption_key
  SIGNING_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/package_signing_key
  CLAMAV_ENABLED: ${CONFORMITI_SCANNING:-false}
  CLAMAV_HOST: clamav
  CLAMAV_PORT: '3310'
  DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-localhost,127.0.0.1,backend}
  CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: ${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080,http://127.0.0.1:8080}
  CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080}
  BEHIND_TLS: ${BEHIND_TLS:-false}
  POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-compliance}
  POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-compliance}
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-compliance}
  POSTGRES_HOST: db
  POSTGRES_PORT: 5432
  CACHE_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/2
  CELERY_BROKER_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/0
  CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/1
  COMPLIANCE_TREE_ROOT: /data/compliance-data
  SEED_DEMO_DATA: ${SEED_DEMO_DATA:-false}
  EMAIL_PROVIDER: ${EMAIL_PROVIDER:-console}
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-compliance}
    volumes:
    - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-compliance} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-compliance}
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
    - redis-server
    - --save
    - ''
    - --appendonly
    - 'no'
    - --maxmemory
    - 256mb
    - --maxmemory-policy
    - volatile-lru
    - --requirepass
    - ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - redis-cli --no-auth-warning -a "$$REDIS_PASSWORD" ping 2>/dev/null | grep
        -q PONG || redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
  backend:
    build: ./backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
    - path: .env
      required: false
    environment:
      DJANGO_DEBUG: ${CONFORMITI_DEBUG:-false}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_SECRET_KEY:-}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_secret_key
      DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-}
      DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_field_encryption_key
      SIGNING_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/package_signing_key
      CLAMAV_ENABLED: ${CONFORMITI_SCANNING:-false}
      CLAMAV_HOST: clamav
      CLAMAV_PORT: '3310'
      DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-localhost,127.0.0.1,backend}
      CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: ${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080,http://127.0.0.1:8080}
      CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080}
      BEHIND_TLS: ${BEHIND_TLS:-false}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_HOST: db
      POSTGRES_PORT: 5432
      CACHE_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/2
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/0
      CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/1
      COMPLIANCE_TREE_ROOT: /data/compliance-data
      SEED_DEMO_DATA: ${SEED_DEMO_DATA:-false}
      EMAIL_PROVIDER: ${EMAIL_PROVIDER:-console}
    volumes:
    - media:/app/media
    - static:/app/staticfiles
    - secrets:/app/secrets
    - tree:/data/compliance-data
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:8000:8000
  worker:
    build: ./backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
    - celery
    - -A
    - config
    - worker
    - -l
    - info
    - --concurrency
    - '2'
    env_file:
    - path: .env
      required: false
    environment:
      DJANGO_DEBUG: ${CONFORMITI_DEBUG:-false}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_SECRET_KEY:-}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_secret_key
      DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-}
      DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_field_encryption_key
      SIGNING_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/package_signing_key
      CLAMAV_ENABLED: ${CONFORMITI_SCANNING:-false}
      CLAMAV_HOST: clamav
      CLAMAV_PORT: '3310'
      DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-localhost,127.0.0.1,backend}
      CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: ${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080,http://127.0.0.1:8080}
      CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080}
      BEHIND_TLS: ${BEHIND_TLS:-false}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_HOST: db
      POSTGRES_PORT: 5432
      CACHE_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/2
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/0
      CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/1
      COMPLIANCE_TREE_ROOT: /data/compliance-data
      SEED_DEMO_DATA: ${SEED_DEMO_DATA:-false}
      EMAIL_PROVIDER: ${EMAIL_PROVIDER:-console}
    volumes:
    - media:/app/media
    - secrets:/app/secrets:ro
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - celery -A config inspect ping -d celery@$$HOSTNAME --timeout 10 >/dev/null
        2>&1 || exit 1
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 15s
      start_period: 60s
      retries: 3
  beat:
    build: ./backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    entrypoint:
    - celery
    - -A
    - config
    - beat
    - -l
    - info
    - -s
    - /tmp/celerybeat-schedule
    - --pidfile
    - /tmp/celerybeat.pid
    env_file:
    - path: .env
      required: false
    environment:
      DJANGO_DEBUG: ${CONFORMITI_DEBUG:-false}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_SECRET_KEY:-}
      DJANGO_SECRET_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_secret_key
      DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${CONFORMITI_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-}
      DJANGO_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/django_field_encryption_key
      SIGNING_KEY_FILE: /app/secrets/package_signing_key
      CLAMAV_ENABLED: ${CONFORMITI_SCANNING:-false}
      CLAMAV_HOST: clamav
      CLAMAV_PORT: '3310'
      DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-localhost,127.0.0.1,backend}
      CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS: ${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080,http://127.0.0.1:8080}
      CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: ${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-http://localhost:8080}
      BEHIND_TLS: ${BEHIND_TLS:-false}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-compliance}
      POSTGRES_HOST: db
      POSTGRES_PORT: 5432
      CACHE_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/2
      CELERY_BROKER_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/0
      CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-}@redis:6379/1
      COMPLIANCE_TREE_ROOT: /data/compliance-data
      SEED_DEMO_DATA: ${SEED_DEMO_DATA:-false}
      EMAIL_PROVIDER: ${EMAIL_PROVIDER:-console}
    volumes:
    - secrets:/app/secrets:ro
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - kill -0 $$(cat /tmp/celerybeat.pid) 2>/dev/null || exit 1
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 3
  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - media:/usr/share/nginx/media:ro
    - static:/usr/share/nginx/static:ro
    ports:
    - ${CONFORMITI_PORT:-8080}:80
  clamav:
    image: clamav/clamav:1.4
    profiles:
    - scanning
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - clamdb:/var/lib/clamav
    - ./docker/clamd.conf:/etc/clamav/clamd.conf:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - clamdcheck.sh || exit 1
      interval: 60s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 300s
volumes:
  clamdb: null
  pgdata: null
  media: null
  static: null
  secrets: null
  tree: null

app.title: compdf-self-hosted
app.description: Edit, convert, and transform documents across PDFs, Office formats, HTML, TXT, CSV, RTF, JSON, and images with ComPDF Self-hosted, an open-source PDF platform. - ComPDFKit/compdf-self-hosted
app.compose_content:
services:
  compdf-infra:
    image: compdfkit/compdf-infra:1.0.0
    platform: ${COMPDF_IMAGE_PLATFORM:-linux/amd64}
    security_opt:
    - seccomp:unconfined
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: compdfkit-ak
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: compdfkit-sk-2026
    volumes:
    - compdf_mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
    - compdf_redis_data:/data/redis
    - compdf_rustfs_data:/data
    mem_limit: 3g
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
    - compdf-internal
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - mysqladmin ping -h 127.0.0.1 -u compdfkit -pcompdfkit-pass-2026 --silent &&
        redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG && curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:9000/
        | grep -qE '^[2-4]'
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 120s
  compdf-app:
    image: compdfkit/compdf-app:1.0.0
    platform: ${COMPDF_IMAGE_PLATFORM:-linux/amd64}
    depends_on:
      compdf-infra:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
    - REDIS_URL=redis://compdf-infra:6379/0
    - MYSQL_HOST=compdf-infra
    - S3_ENDPOINT=http://compdf-infra:9000
    - COMPDF_LICENSE_KEY=${COMPDF_LICENSE_KEY}
    - COMPDFKIT_LICENSE=${COMPDF_LICENSE_KEY}
    ports:
    - 7000:7000
    - 7001:7001
    - 9903:9903
    volumes:
    - ./fonts/windows:/opt/compdf_sdk/fonts/windows:ro
    - compdf_output:/tmp/compdf_output
    - compdf_pdf_data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    mem_limit: 16g
    networks:
    - compdf-internal
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:7000/health',timeout=3).status==200
        else 1)
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 120s
  compdf-server:
    image: compdfkit/compdf-server:1.0.0
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      target: production
    ports:
    - 8080:8080
    depends_on:
      compdf-infra:
        condition: service_healthy
      compdf-app:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
    - compdf-internal
    environment:
    - PDF_SDK_BASE_URL=${PDF_SDK_BASE_URL:-http://compdf-app:7001}
    - CONVERSION_BASE_URL=${CONVERSION_BASE_URL:-http://compdf-app:7000}
    volumes:
    - ./configs:/app/configs
    - ./data/server-storage:/app/storage
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - npm run init:db && npm run start
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - node
      - -e
      - fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/status').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 30s
volumes:
  compdf_output: null
  compdf_redis_data: null
  compdf_pdf_data: null
  compdf_mysql_data: null
  compdf_rustfs_data: null
networks:
  compdf-internal:
    driver: bridge

app.title: 4gaBoards
app.description: Straightforward realtime kanban boards management for intuitive task tracking. 4ga Boards features an elegant dark mode, collapsible todo lists, and multitasking tools to supercharge your team&#39;...
app.compose_content:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    restart: always
    networks:
    - boards-network
    volumes:
    - db-data-18:/var/lib/postgresql
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: 4gaBoards
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: notpassword
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: -A scram-sha-256
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U postgres -d 4gaBoards
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
  redis:
    image: redis:8-alpine
    restart: always
    networks:
    - boards-network
    volumes:
    - redis-data-8:/data
    command:
    - redis-server
    - --appendonly
    - 'yes'
    - --requirepass
    - notredispassword
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - redis-cli -a "notredispassword" ping | grep PONG
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
  4gaBoards:
    image: ghcr.io/rargames/4gaboards:latest
    restart: always
    networks:
    - boards-network
    volumes:
    - user-avatars:/app/public/user-avatars
    - project-background-images:/app/public/project-background-images
    - attachments:/app/private/attachments
    ports:
    - 3000:1337
    environment:
      BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
      SECRET_KEY: notsecretkey
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://postgres:notpassword@db/4gaBoards
      NODE_ENV: production
      UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_STORE: redis
      UPLOAD_RATE_LIMIT_REDIS_URL: redis://:notredispassword@redis:6379/0
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

app.title: freeframe
app.description: Open source alternative for frame.io. Contribute to Techiebutler/freeframe development by creating an account on GitHub.
app.compose_content:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: freeframe
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: freeframe
      POSTGRES_DB: freeframe
    ports:
    - 5433:5432
    volumes:
    - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U freeframe
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
    - 6379:6379
    volumes:
    - redisdata:/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - redis-cli
      - ping
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-04-22T22-12-26Z
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: minioadmin
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: minioadmin
      MINIO_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN: ${MINIO_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN:-http://localhost:3000}
      MINIO_CORS_ALLOW_METHODS: GET,PUT,POST,DELETE,HEAD
      MINIO_CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS: '*'
      MINIO_CORS_EXPOSE_HEADERS: ETag,Content-Length,x-amz-request-id
    ports:
    - 9000:9000
    - 9001:9001
    volumes:
    - miniodata:/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  minio-init:
    image: minio/mc:latest
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint: '/bin/sh -c " mc alias set local http://minio:9000 minioadmin minioadmin;
      mc mb --ignore-existing local/freeframe; mc anonymous set download local/freeframe;
      exit 0; "

      '
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    ports:
    - 8000:8000
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://freeframe:freeframe@postgres:5432/freeframe
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      S3_STORAGE: ${S3_STORAGE:-minio}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: ${S3_BUCKET:-freeframe}
      S3_REGION: ${S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
      S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT: ${S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT:-http://localhost:9000}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - ./apps/api:/workspace/apps/api
    - ./packages/transcoder:/workspace/packages/transcoder
    command: 'sh -c "cd /workspace/apps/api && alembic upgrade head && cd /workspace
      && uvicorn apps.api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload"

      '
  worker:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://freeframe:freeframe@postgres:5432/freeframe
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      S3_STORAGE: ${S3_STORAGE:-minio}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: ${S3_BUCKET:-freeframe}
      S3_REGION: ${S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - ./apps/api:/workspace/apps/api
    - ./packages/transcoder:/workspace/packages/transcoder
    command: celery -A apps.api.tasks.celery_app worker -Q transcoding -c ${TRANSCODING_CONCURRENCY:-2}
      --loglevel=info
  email_worker:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://freeframe:freeframe@postgres:5432/freeframe
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      S3_STORAGE: ${S3_STORAGE:-minio}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: ${S3_BUCKET:-freeframe}
      S3_REGION: ${S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - ./apps/api:/workspace/apps/api
    - ./packages/transcoder:/workspace/packages/transcoder
    command: celery -A apps.api.tasks.celery_app worker -Q email_high,email_low -c
      ${EMAIL_CONCURRENCY:-2} --loglevel=info
  maintenance_worker:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://freeframe:freeframe@postgres:5432/freeframe
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      S3_STORAGE: ${S3_STORAGE:-minio}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: ${S3_BUCKET:-freeframe}
      S3_REGION: ${S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - ./apps/api:/workspace/apps/api
    - ./packages/transcoder:/workspace/packages/transcoder
    command: celery -A apps.api.tasks.celery_app worker -Q maintenance -c ${MAINTENANCE_CONCURRENCY:-1}
      --loglevel=info
  beat:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: apps/api/Dockerfile
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://freeframe:freeframe@postgres:5432/freeframe
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      S3_STORAGE: ${S3_STORAGE:-minio}
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-minioadmin}
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: ${S3_BUCKET:-freeframe}
      S3_REGION: ${S3_REGION:-us-east-1}
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
    - ./apps/api:/workspace/apps/api
    - ./packages/transcoder:/workspace/packages/transcoder
    command: celery -A apps.api.tasks.celery_app beat --loglevel=info -s /tmp/celerybeat-schedule
  web:
    image: node:20-alpine
    working_dir: /app
    ports:
    - 3000:3000
    environment:
    - NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:-http://localhost:8000}
    - API_INTERNAL_URL=${API_INTERNAL_URL:-http://api:8000}
    - NODE_ENV=development
    - HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
    volumes:
    - ./apps/web:/app
    - web_node_modules:/app/node_modules
    command: sh -c "npm install && npx next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0"
    depends_on:
    - api
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - wget
      - -q
      - --spider
      - http://localhost:3000
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 60s
volumes:
  pgdata: null
  miniodata: null
  redisdata: null
  web_node_modules: null

app.title: linse-app
app.description: Self-hosted photo sharing for events. Contribute to jmsz1996/linse-app development by creating an account on GitHub.
app.compose_content:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: linse-db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: linse
      POSTGRES_USER: linse
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
    - linse_pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U linse -d linse
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped
  fix-permissions:
    image: busybox
    volumes:
    - linse_uploads:/data/uploads
    command: chown -R 100:101 /data/uploads
    restart: 'no'
  fix-permissions-exports:
    image: busybox
    volumes:
    - ${EXPORT_DIR:-./exports}:/data/exports
    command: chown -R 100:101 /data/exports
    restart: 'no'
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/jmsz1996/linse-app:${LINSE_VERSION:-latest}
    container_name: linse-app
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://linse:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@db:5432/linse
      AUTH_SECRET: ${AUTH_SECRET}
      LINSE_SECRET: ${LINSE_SECRET}
      AUTH_TRUST_HOST: 'true'
      LINSE_INSECURE_COOKIES: ${LINSE_INSECURE_COOKIES:-false}
      HOST_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${HOST_ADMIN_EMAIL}
      HOST_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${HOST_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      UPLOAD_DIR: /data/uploads
    ports:
    - ${LINSE_PORT:-3000}:3000
    volumes:
    - linse_uploads:/data/uploads
    - ${EXPORT_DIR:-./exports}:/data/exports
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - wget
      - -qO-
      - http://localhost:3000/api/health
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 40s
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      fix-permissions:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      fix-permissions-exports:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  linse_pgdata:
    name: linse_pgdata
  linse_uploads:
    name: linse_uploads

app.title: moneat
app.description: Contribute to moneat-io/moneat development by creating an account on GitHub.
app.compose_content:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    container_name: moneat-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: moneat
      POSTGRES_USER: moneat
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    ports:
    - ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5499}:5432
    volumes:
    - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    - ./backend/src/main/resources/db/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U moneat
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  clickhouse:
    image: clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.5-alpine
    container_name: moneat-clickhouse
    environment:
      CLICKHOUSE_DB: moneat
      CLICKHOUSE_USER: moneat
      CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD: ${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
      CLICKHOUSE_DEFAULT_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT: 1
    ports:
    - ${CLICKHOUSE_HTTP_PORT:-8123}:8123
    - ${CLICKHOUSE_NATIVE_PORT:-9000}:9000
    volumes:
    - clickhouse_data:/var/lib/clickhouse
    - ./backend/src/main/resources/db/clickhouse_init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/clickhouse_init.sql
    - ./clickhouse-config/logging.xml:/etc/clickhouse-server/config.d/logging.xml
    ulimits:
      nofile:
        soft: 262144
        hard: 262144
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - wget
      - --spider
      - -q
      - 127.0.0.1:8123/ping
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  redis:
    image: redis:8-alpine
    container_name: moneat-redis
    ports:
    - ${REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
    volumes:
    - redis_data:/data
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes --requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - redis-cli -a $$REDIS_PASSWORD --no-auth-warning ping
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  temporal-bootstrap:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    container_name: moneat-temporal-bootstrap
    restart: 'no'
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      PGPASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
    command:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    - "psql -h postgres -U moneat -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 \\\n  -v temporal_user=\"\
      ${TEMPORAL_DB_USER:-temporal}\" \\\n  -v temporal_password=\"${TEMPORAL_DB_PASSWORD:-temporal_dev_password}\"\
      \ <<'SQL'\nSELECT format('CREATE ROLE %I LOGIN PASSWORD %L', :'temporal_user',\
      \ :'temporal_password')\nWHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname\
      \ = :'temporal_user') \\gexec\nSELECT format('ALTER ROLE %I WITH PASSWORD %L',\
      \ :'temporal_user', :'temporal_password') \\gexec\nSELECT format('CREATE DATABASE\
      \ temporal OWNER %I', :'temporal_user')\nWHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_database\
      \ WHERE datname = 'temporal') \\gexec\nSELECT format('CREATE DATABASE temporal_visibility\
      \ OWNER %I', :'temporal_user')\nWHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_database\
      \ WHERE datname = 'temporal_visibility') \\gexec\nSQL\n"
  temporal:
    image: temporalio/auto-setup:1.27.4
    container_name: moneat-temporal
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      temporal-bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      DB: postgres12
      DB_PORT: 5432
      SKIP_DB_CREATE: 'true'
      DEFAULT_NAMESPACE: ${TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE:-default}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${TEMPORAL_DB_USER:-temporal}
      POSTGRES_PWD: ${TEMPORAL_DB_PASSWORD:-temporal_dev_password}
      POSTGRES_SEEDS: postgres
      DBNAME: temporal
      VISIBILITY_DBNAME: temporal_visibility
    ports:
    - ${TEMPORAL_GRPC_PORT:-7233}:7233
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - temporal
      - operator
      - cluster
      - health
      - --address
      - temporal:7233
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 40s
  temporal-ui:
    image: temporalio/ui:2.34.0
    container_name: moneat-temporal-ui
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      temporal:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      TEMPORAL_ADDRESS: temporal:7233
    ports:
    - ${TEMPORAL_UI_PORT:-8233}:8080
  backend:
    image: ghcr.io/moneat-io/moneat-backend:latest
    container_name: moneat-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
    - ${BACKEND_PORT:-8080}:8080
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/moneat
      DATABASE_USER: moneat
      DATABASE_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
      CLICKHOUSE_URL: http://clickhouse:8123
      CLICKHOUSE_USER: moneat
      CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD: ${CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}
      REDIS_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD:-moneat_dev_password}@redis:6379
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET:-dev-jwt-secret-change-in-production}
      DATA_SOURCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: ${DATA_SOURCE_ENCRYPTION_KEY:-}
      TEMPORAL_TARGET: ${TEMPORAL_TARGET:-temporal:7233}
      TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE: ${TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE:-default}
      WORKFLOWS_CONNECTION_KEK: ${WORKFLOWS_CONNECTION_KEK:-}
      WORKFLOWS_SIGNING_KEY: ${WORKFLOWS_SIGNING_KEY:-}
      WORKFLOWS_TEMPORAL_PAYLOAD_KEY: ${WORKFLOWS_TEMPORAL_PAYLOAD_KEY:-}
      FRONTEND_URL: ${FRONTEND_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
      BACKEND_URL: ${BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:8080}
      STRIPE_ENABLED: 'false'
      SELF_HOSTED: 'true'
      MONEAT_LICENSE_KEY: ${MONEAT_LICENSE_KEY:-}
    volumes:
    - backend_storage:/app/storage
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      clickhouse:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      temporal:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - wget
      - -q
      - -O
      - /dev/null
      - http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
  frontend:
    image: ghcr.io/moneat-io/moneat-dashboard:latest
    container_name: moneat-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
    - ${FRONTEND_PORT:-3000}:80
    environment:
      VITE_BACKEND_URL: ${BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:8080}
      VITE_MONEAT_VERSION: ${MONEAT_VERSION:-}
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
  datadog-agent:
    profiles:
    - datadog
    image: datadog/agent:${DATADOG_AGENT_TAG:-7}
    container_name: moneat-datadog-agent
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      DD_API_KEY: ${DD_API_KEY:-}
      DD_DD_URL: ${DD_DD_URL:-https://api.moneat.io/dd}
      DD_ENV: ${DD_ENV:-production}
      DD_HOSTNAME: ${DD_HOSTNAME:-moneat-host}
      DD_APM_ENABLED: 'true'
      DD_APM_NON_LOCAL_TRAFFIC: 'true'
      DD_APM_CONFIG_PROFILING_DD_URL: ${DD_APM_CONFIG_PROFILING_DD_URL:-https://api.moneat.io/api/v2/profile?api_key=${DD_API_KEY:-}}
      DD_PROCESS_AGENT_ENABLED: 'true'
      DD_LOGS_ENABLED: 'true'
      DD_LOGS_CONFIG_LOGS_DD_URL: ${DD_LOGS_DD_URL:-api.moneat.io:443}
      DD_LOGS_CONFIG_LOGS_NO_SSL: 'false'
      DD_LOGS_CONFIG_CONTAINER_COLLECT_ALL: 'true'
      DD_DYNAMIC_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED: 'true'
      DD_SYSTEM_PROBE_ENABLED: 'true'
      DD_SYSTEM_PROBE_NETWORK_ENABLED: 'true'
    volumes:
    - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
    - /proc/:/host/proc/:ro
    - /sys/fs/cgroup/:/host/sys/fs/cgroup:ro
    - /sys/kernel/debug:/sys/kernel/debug:ro
    ports:
    - 8126:8126
    - 8125:8125
    cap_add:
    - SYS_ADMIN
    - SYS_RESOURCE
    - SYS_PTRACE
    - NET_ADMIN
    - NET_BROADCAST
    security_opt:
    - apparmor:unconfined
volumes:
  postgres_data: null
  clickhouse_data: null
  redis_data: null
  backend_storage: null

    environment:

    - gateway-data:/data
    healthcheck:

  whisper-models-init:
    image: dictionlabs/whisper-server:latest-cpu
    container_name: diction-whisper-models-init
    user: root
    profiles:
    - small
    - medium
    - large

    - sh
    - -c
    - chown -R 1000:1000 /cache

      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 120s

      EFFECTIVENESS_STORE_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/effectiveness-state.json
      EMBEDDING_API_BASE: ${FLAWLESS_DOCKER_EMBEDDING_API_BASE:-http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1}
      HEALING_AGENT_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8101/a2a/tasks

      KNOWLEDGE_STORE_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/knowledge-base.json

      OPS_SKILL_ROOT: /var/lib/flawless/ops-skills

app.title: inky-bird-frame
app.description: Turn bird observations and detections into reviewed, reusable field-journal plates for color e-paper displays - veteranbv/inky-bird-frame
app.compose_content:
name: inky-bird-frame
x-controller-common:
  image: ${INKY_BIRD_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/veteranbv/inky-bird-frame:latest}
  read_only: true
  cap_drop: &id001
  - ALL
  pids_limit: 256
  tmpfs: &id002
  - /tmp:size=256m,mode=1777
  volumes: &id003
  - controller-data:/data
services:
  config-sync:
    image: ${INKY_BIRD_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/veteranbv/inky-bird-frame:latest}
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: *id001
    pids_limit: 256
    tmpfs: *id002
    volumes:
    - controller-data:/data
    - type: bind
      source: ${INKY_BIRD_CONFIG:-./config.toml}
      target: /run/inky/config.toml
      read_only: true
      bind:
        create_host_path: false
        selinux: Z
    user: 0:0
    cap_add:
    - CHOWN
    - DAC_OVERRIDE
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    network_mode: none
    env_file:
    - path: ${INKY_BIRD_ENV:-./controller.env}
      required: false
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    command:
    - if ! test -r /run/inky/config.toml; then echo 'config-sync cannot read the host
      config; see docs/docker.md#user-namespace-remapping' >&2; exit 1; fi; inky-bird-frame
      config install --destination /data/config.toml < /run/inky/config.toml && exec
      chown 10001:10001 /data/config.toml
    restart: 'no'
  bootstrap:
    image: ${INKY_BIRD_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/veteranbv/inky-bird-frame:latest}
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: *id001
    pids_limit: 256
    tmpfs: *id002
    volumes: *id003
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    environment:
      INKY_CATALOG_SYNC_APPLY_REVIEWED_MIGRATIONS: '1'
      INKY_CATALOG_SYNC_RETAIN_INDEPENDENT_APPROVALS: '1'
    command:
    - catalog
    - sync
    - --source-catalog
    - /app/catalog
    - --catalog
    - /data/catalog
    - --state-dir
    - /data/var/controller
    depends_on:
      config-sync:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    restart: 'no'
  controller:
    image: ${INKY_BIRD_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/veteranbv/inky-bird-frame:latest}
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: *id001
    pids_limit: 256
    tmpfs: *id002
    volumes: *id003
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    command:
    - serve
    - --config
    - /data/config.toml
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    ports:
    - ${INKY_BIRD_PORT:-8793}:8793
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8793/health',
        timeout=5).read()
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
  scheduler:
    image: ${INKY_BIRD_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/veteranbv/inky-bird-frame:latest}
    read_only: true
    cap_drop: *id001
    pids_limit: 256
    tmpfs: *id002
    volumes:
    - controller-data:/data
    - codex-auth:/home/inky/.codex
    - github-auth:/home/inky/.config
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    - seccomp=unconfined
    - apparmor=unconfined
    env_file:
    - path: ${INKY_BIRD_ENV:-./controller.env}
      required: false
    command:
    - scheduler
    - --config
    - /data/config.toml
    depends_on:
      bootstrap:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      controller:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  controller-data: null
  codex-auth: null
  github-auth: null

app.description: AI SRE AgenticOps for Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure. - William-Lu-stack/Flawless
app.compose_content:
name: flawless
services:
  flawless:
    image: ${FLAWLESS_IMAGE:-flawless-local:latest}
    build:
      context: .
      target: backend-runtime
      args:
        NODE_IMAGE: ${FLAWLESS_NODE_IMAGE:-node:24-slim}
        PYTHON_IMAGE: ${FLAWLESS_PYTHON_IMAGE:-python:3.13-slim}
        NGINX_IMAGE: ${FLAWLESS_NGINX_IMAGE:-nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:stable-alpine3.23@sha256:b3f2436575bd5be7386518084d842dac414ab4962712afa31e99e0942a56e3b2}
        NPM_REGISTRY: ${FLAWLESS_NPM_REGISTRY:-https://registry.npmjs.org}
        PIP_INDEX_URL: ${FLAWLESS_PIP_INDEX_URL:-https://pypi.org/simple}
        PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL: ${FLAWLESS_PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL:-}
        PIP_TRUSTED_HOST: ${FLAWLESS_PIP_TRUSTED_HOST:-}
        DEBIAN_MIRROR: ${FLAWLESS_DEBIAN_MIRROR:-http://deb.debian.org/debian}
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
      ADAPTER_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8200
      CMDB_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8300
      EFFECTIVENESS_STORE_FALLBACK_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/effectiveness-state.fallback.json
      EFFECTIVENESS_STORE_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/effectiveness-state.json
      EMBEDDING_API_BASE: ${FLAWLESS_DOCKER_EMBEDDING_API_BASE:-http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1}
      HEALING_AGENT_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8101/a2a/tasks
      INCIDENT_AGENT_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8102/a2a/tasks
      KNOWLEDGE_STORE_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/knowledge-base.json
      LLM_API_BASE: ${FLAWLESS_DOCKER_LLM_API_BASE:-http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1}
      MCP_SERVER_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8105/mcp
      MODEL_PROFILES_STORE: /var/lib/flawless/model-profiles.json
      OBSERVABILITY_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8100
      OPS_SKILL_ROOT: /var/lib/flawless/ops-skills
      OPS_SKILL_STORE_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/ops-skills.json
      POSTMORTEM_AGENT_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8103/a2a/tasks
      RELIABILITY_STORE_FALLBACK_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/reliability-state.fallback.json
      RELIABILITY_STORE_PATH: /var/lib/flawless/reliability-state.json
    extra_hosts:
    - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:${FLAWLESS_PORT:-8080}:8080
    volumes:
    - flawless-data:/var/lib/flawless
    command:
    - python
    - scripts/run_local_stack.py
    - --host
    - 0.0.0.0
    - --api-port
    - '8080'
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - --fail
      - --silent
      - http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 20s
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  flawless-data: null

app.title: agentic-operator-core
app.description: Runtime-agnostic Kubernetes governance for AI agents: gVisor isolation, egress policy, cost controls, and offline audit verification primitives.
app.compose_content:
services:
  litellm-proxy:
    image: ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:main-latest
    container_name: swarm-litellm
    ports:
    - 8000:8000
    environment:
      AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: ${AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT:-}
      AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY:-}
      AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION: ${AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION:-}
      LITELLM_LOG: DEBUG
    volumes:
    - ./config/litellm_config.yaml:/app/config.yaml
    networks:
    - swarm-net
    command: --config /app/config.yaml --port 8000
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - python -c "import urllib.request; r=urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:8000/health/liveliness');
        urllib.request.urlopen(r).read()"
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 30s
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: swarm-postgres
    ports:
    - 5432:5432
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-spans}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-spans_dev}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-spans}
    volumes:
    - swarm-pg-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    - ./config/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql
    networks:
    - swarm-net
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-spans}
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    container_name: swarm-minio
    ports:
    - 9090:9090
    - 9004:9000
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: ${MINIO_ROOT_USER:-minioadmin}
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD:-minioadmin123}
    volumes:
    - swarm-minio-data:/data
    command: minio server /data --console-address ":9090"
    networks:
    - swarm-net
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
  analyst:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: examples/multi-agent-swarm/docker/Dockerfile.agent
      args:
        AGENT_TYPE: analyst
    container_name: analyst-agent
    ports:
    - 9001:8080
    environment:
      AGENT_ROLE: analyst
      AGENT_TONE: neutral_academic
      LITELLM_PROXY_URL: http://litellm-proxy:8000
      LITELLM_KEY: sk-analyst-virtual
      MINIO_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      MINIO_BUCKET: agentic-demo
      POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-spans}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-spans_dev}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-spans}
      STRATEGIST_URL: http://strategist:8080
      AUTO_APPROVE_THRESHOLD: ${AUTO_APPROVE_THRESHOLD:-0.95}
      OPA_POLICY_MODE: ${OPA_POLICY_MODE:-strict}
      AGENT_BUDGET_LIMIT_USD: ${AGENT_BUDGET_LIMIT_USD:-25.0}
      LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    depends_on:
      litellm-proxy:
        condition: service_healthy
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
    - swarm-net
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:8080/health
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
  strategist:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: examples/multi-agent-swarm/docker/Dockerfile.agent
      args:
        AGENT_TYPE: strategist
    container_name: strategist-agent
    ports:
    - 9002:8080
    environment:
      AGENT_ROLE: strategist
      AGENT_TONE: decisive_professional
      LITELLM_PROXY_URL: http://litellm-proxy:8000
      LITELLM_KEY: sk-strategist-virtual
      MINIO_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      MINIO_BUCKET: agentic-demo
      POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-spans}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-spans_dev}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-spans}
      AUTO_APPROVE_THRESHOLD: ${AUTO_APPROVE_THRESHOLD:-0.95}
      OPA_POLICY_MODE: ${OPA_POLICY_MODE:-strict}
      AGENT_BUDGET_LIMIT_USD: ${AGENT_BUDGET_LIMIT_USD:-25.0}
      LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    depends_on:
      litellm-proxy:
        condition: service_healthy
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
    - swarm-net
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:8080/health
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
  orchestrator:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: examples/multi-agent-swarm/docker/Dockerfile.orchestrator
    container_name: swarm-orchestrator
    ports:
    - 9000:9000
    environment:
      ANALYST_URL: http://analyst:8080
      STRATEGIST_URL: http://strategist:8080
      STAGE_TIMEOUT: '60'
      LOG_LEVEL: INFO
    depends_on:
      analyst:
        condition: service_healthy
      strategist:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
    - swarm-net
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:9000/health
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3

app.title: ChatbotX
app.description: Open-source ManyChat alternative, built for AI. Omnichannel marketing across WhatsApp, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Telegram, Zalo, Email, API, and Webchat 🤖
app.compose_content:
name: chatbotx
x-network:
  networks: &id001
  - chatbotx-network
x-rustfs-environment:
  RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY:-chatbotx}
  RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY:-secretkey}
  RUSTFS_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN: ${RUSTFS_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN:-*}
services:
  postgres:
    networks: *id001
    image: timescale/timescaledb-ha:pg18-all
    ports:
    - 5432:5432
    volumes:
    - db-data:/home/postgres/pgdata
    command:
    - postgres
    - -c
    - log_statement=${POSTGRES_LOG_STATEMENT:-none}
    environment:
    - POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-chatbotx}
    - POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER:-chatbotx}
    - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-secretkey}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -d $${POSTGRES_DB} -U $${POSTGRES_USER}
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s
  adminer:
    networks: *id001
    image: adminer:latest
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
    - ${ADMINER_PORT:-8080}:8080
  mailhog:
    networks: *id001
    image: mailhog/mailhog
    ports:
    - 1025:1025
    - 8025:8025
  filesystem:
    networks: *id001
    image: rustfs/rustfs:latest
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    ports:
    - 9000:9000
    - 9001:9001
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY:-chatbotx}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY:-secretkey}
      RUSTFS_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN: ${RUSTFS_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN:-*}
    volumes:
    - filesystem-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - sh
      - -c
      - curl -f http://127.0.0.1:9000/health && curl -f http://127.0.0.1:9001/rustfs/console/health
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
  filesystem-init:
    networks: *id001
    image: rustfs/rc:latest
    depends_on:
      filesystem:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY:-chatbotx}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY:-secretkey}
      RUSTFS_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN: ${RUSTFS_API_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN:-*}
    entrypoint: '/bin/sh -c "rc alias set local http://filesystem:9000 $${RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY}
      $${RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY}; rc mb local/chatbotx --ignore-existing; touch /tmp/empty
      && rc cp /tmp/empty local/chatbotx/public/; rc anonymous set public local/chatbotx/public;"

      '
  redis:
    networks: *id001
    image: redis:8-alpine
    ports:
    - 6379:6379
    volumes:
    - cache-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - redis-cli
      - ping
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  redis-ui:
    networks: *id001
    image: redis/redisinsight:latest
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
    - 5540:5540
    volumes:
    - redis-ui-data:/data
networks:
  chatbotx-network:
    driver: bridge
volumes:
  db-data: null
  filesystem-data: null
  cache-data: null
  redis-ui-data: null

app.title: brainapi2
app.description: BrainAPI is a knowledge graph–powered AI memory layer that transforms unstructured data into structured knowledge, enabling intelligent search, recommendations, and contextual memory for AI agents and applications.
app.compose_content:
version: '3.5'
services:
  etcd:
    container_name: milvus-etcd
    image: quay.io/coreos/etcd:v3.5.18
    environment:
    - ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_MODE=revision
    - ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_RETENTION=1000
    - ETCD_QUOTA_BACKEND_BYTES=4294967296
    - ETCD_SNAPSHOT_COUNT=50000
    volumes:
    - ${DOCKER_VOLUME_DIRECTORY:-.}/volumes/etcd:/etcd
    command: etcd -advertise-client-urls=http://etcd:2379 -listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379
      --data-dir /etcd
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - etcdctl
      - endpoint
      - health
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
  minio:
    container_name: milvus-minio
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2024-12-18T13-15-44Z
    environment:
      MINIO_ACCESS_KEY: minioadmin
      MINIO_SECRET_KEY: minioadmin
    ports:
    - 9001:9001
    - 9000:9000
    volumes:
    - ${DOCKER_VOLUME_DIRECTORY:-.}/volumes/minio:/minio_data
    command: minio server /minio_data --console-address ":9001"
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
  standalone:
    container_name: milvus-standalone
    image: milvusdb/milvus:v2.6.4
    command:
    - milvus
    - run
    - standalone
    security_opt:
    - seccomp:unconfined
    environment:
      ETCD_ENDPOINTS: etcd:2379
      MINIO_ADDRESS: minio:9000
      MQ_TYPE: woodpecker
    volumes:
    - ${DOCKER_VOLUME_DIRECTORY:-.}/volumes/milvus:/var/lib/milvus
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -f
      - http://localhost:9091/healthz
      interval: 30s
      start_period: 90s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 3
    ports:
    - 19530:19530
    - 9091:9091
    depends_on:
    - etcd
    - minio
networks:
  default:
    name: milvus

app.title: AudioMuse-AI
app.description: AudioMuse-AI uses sonic analysis to rediscover forgotten songs, uncover hidden connections in your music library, and generate intelligent playlists for Navidrome, Jellyfin, LMS, Lyrion, Emby and Plex: no metadata or external services required.
app.compose_content:
version: '3.8'
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: audiomuse-postgres
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ:-UTC}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-audiomuse}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-audiomusepassword}
      POSTGRES_DB: audiomusedb
    ports:
    - ${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}:5432
    volumes:
    - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
  audiomuse-ai-flask:
    image: ghcr.io/neptunehub/audiomuse-ai:latest
    container_name: audiomuse-ai-flask-app
    ports:
    - ${FRONTEND_PORT:-8000}:8000
    environment:
      SERVICE_TYPE: flask
      TZ: ${TZ:-UTC}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-audiomuse}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-audiomusepassword}
      POSTGRES_DB: audiomusedb
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      POSTGRES_PORT: '5432'
      TEMP_DIR: /app/temp_audio
    volumes:
    - temp-audio-flask:/app/temp_audio
    - plugins-flask:/app/plugin/installed
    depends_on:
    - postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
  audiomuse-ai-worker:
    image: ghcr.io/neptunehub/audiomuse-ai:latest
    container_name: audiomuse-ai-worker-instance
    environment:
      SERVICE_TYPE: worker
      TZ: ${TZ:-UTC}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-audiomuse}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-audiomusepassword}
      POSTGRES_DB: audiomusedb
      POSTGRES_HOST: postgres
      POSTGRES_PORT: '5432'
      TEMP_DIR: /app/temp_audio
    volumes:
    - temp-audio-worker:/app/temp_audio
    - plugins-worker:/app/plugin/installed
    depends_on:
    - postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  postgres-data: null
  temp-audio-flask: null
  temp-audio-worker: null
  plugins-flask: null
  plugins-worker: null

    - ${AGENT_DATA_DIR}:/home/nanobot/.nanobot
    - ${MEMORY_VAULT_DIR}:/home/nanobot/.nanobot/workspace/vault:ro
    - ../../.stack:/setup-state:ro

app.title: digarr
app.description: Self-hosted music discovery for your library. Find artists and albums, review recommendations, and send them to Lidarr, slskd, or playlists. Bring your own AI provider or local model. Works without...
app.compose_content:
secrets:
  postgres_password:
    file: ./secrets/postgres_password
networks:
  frontend: null
  backend:
    internal: true
services:
  app:
    image: docker.io/iuliandita/digarr:latest
    user: 1000:1000
    networks:
    - frontend
    - backend
    env_file:
    - path: .env
      required: false
    environment:
    - PORT=3000
    - DB_HOST=postgres
    - DB_USER=${DB_USER:-digarr}
    - DB_NAME=${DB_NAME:-digarr}
    - DB_PASS_FILE=/run/secrets/postgres_password
    secrets:
    - postgres_password
    ports:
    - ${PORT:-3000}:3000
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - /app/healthcheck.sh
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      start_period: 30s
      retries: 3
    read_only: true
    volumes:
    - backups:/app/backups
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512M
          cpus: '2.0'
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: '3'
    restart: unless-stopped
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine@sha256:18cfe3ef5e6815560c98237d6216d1e5119702fb0f3894c8785dd58b8bbe5d73
    networks:
    - backend
    env_file:
    - path: .env
      required: false
    environment:
    - POSTGRES_USER=${DB_USER:-digarr}
    - POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/postgres_password
    - POSTGRES_DB=${DB_NAME:-digarr}
    secrets:
    - postgres_password
    volumes:
    - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U ${DB_USER:-digarr}
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    cap_add:
    - SETUID
    - SETGID
    - CHOWN
    - FOWNER
    - DAC_READ_SEARCH
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 256M
          cpus: '1.0'
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: '3'
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  pgdata: null
  backups: null

services:

app.title: geopulse
app.description: A self-hosted, privacy-first location timeline platform: an open-source alternative to Google Timeline with automatic trip detection, Immich integration, and rich analytics. - tess1o/geopulse
app.compose_content:
services:
  geopulse-keygen:
    image: alpine:latest
    container_name: geopulse-keygen
    restart: 'no'
    volumes:
    - ./keys:/keys
    command:
    - sh
    - -ec
    - "set -e\nmkdir -p /keys\nif [ ! -f /keys/jwt-private-key.pem ] || [ ! -f /keys/jwt-public-key.pem\
      \ ]; then\n  command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1 || apk add --no-cache openssl\n\
      \  openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out /keys/jwt-private-key.pem\n  openssl\
      \ rsa -pubout -in /keys/jwt-private-key.pem -out /keys/jwt-public-key.pem\n\
      \  chmod 644 /keys/jwt-private-key.pem /keys/jwt-public-key.pem\nfi\nif [ !\
      \ -f /keys/ai-encryption-key.txt ]; then\n  command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1\
      \ || apk add --no-cache openssl\n  openssl rand -base64 32 > /keys/ai-encryption-key.txt\n\
      \  chmod 644 /keys/ai-encryption-key.txt\nfi\n"
  geopulse-backend:
    image: tess1o/geopulse-backend:${GEOPULSE_VERSION}-native
    container_name: geopulse-backend
    mem_limit: 512m
    mem_reservation: 128m
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
    - .env
    environment:
    - GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_URL=jdbc:postgresql://${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_HOST}:${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_PORT}/${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_DB}
    volumes:
    - ./keys:/app/keys
    - ./import-drop:/data/geopulse-import
    - ./backups:/data/geopulse-backups
    depends_on:
      geopulse-keygen:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
      geopulse-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - curl -f http://localhost:8080/api/health || exit 1
      interval: 3s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 5s
  geopulse-ui:
    image: tess1o/geopulse-ui:${GEOPULSE_VERSION}
    container_name: geopulse-ui
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
    - .env
    ports:
    - 5555:80
    depends_on:
      geopulse-backend:
        condition: service_healthy
  geopulse-postgres:
    image: postgis/postgis:17-3.5
    container_name: geopulse-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_USERNAME}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_DB}
    volumes:
    - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    command: 'postgres -c timezone=UTC -c shared_buffers=${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_SHARED_BUFFERS:-256MB}
      -c work_mem=${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_WORK_MEM:-8MB} -c maintenance_work_mem=${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_MAINTENANCE_WORK_MEM:-64MB}
      -c effective_cache_size=${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_EFFECTIVE_CACHE_SIZE:-1GB} -c max_wal_size=${GEOPULSE_POSTGRES_MAX_WAL_SIZE:-512MB}

app.title: local-llm
app.description: Everything I know about running LLMs locally. Contribute to jamesob/local-llm development by creating an account on GitHub.
app.compose_content:
services:
  glm52:
    image: ${IMAGE:-voipmonitor/vllm:eldritch-enlightenment-v8722ac7-b12x8ce61f9-cu132-20260629}
    container_name: glm52
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: 32g
    gpus: all
    init: true
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
      nofile:
        soft: 1048576
        hard: 1048576
      stack: 67108864
    volumes:
    - ${MODEL_DIR:-/home/james/storage/models}:/models:ro
    - ${HF_HOME:-/home/james/storage/huggingface}:/root/.cache/huggingface
    - vllm-glm52-594b:/cache
    environment:
      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: 0,1,2,3
      CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER: PCI_BUS_ID
      CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS: '32'
      CUTE_DSL_ARCH: sm_120a
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: '16'
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU: '1'
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: '1'
      NCCL_P2P_LEVEL: SYS
      NCCL_PROTO: LL,LL128,Simple
      VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE: ${VLLM_USE_AOT_COMPILE:-1}
      VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH: '0'
      VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT: ${VLLM_USE_MEGA_AOT_ARTIFACT:-1}
      VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER: '1'
      VLLM_USE_B12X_FP8_GEMM: '1'
      VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE: '1'
      VLLM_USE_B12X_SPARSE_INDEXER: '1'
      VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER: '1'
      VLLM_ENABLE_PCIE_ALLREDUCE: '1'
      VLLM_PCIE_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND: b12x
      VLLM_PCIE_ONESHOT_ALLREDUCE_MAX_SIZE: 64KB
      B12X_DENSE_SPLITK_TURBO: '1'
      B12X_W4A16_TC_DECODE: '1'
      B12X_MOE_FORCE_A16: '1'
      VLLM_CACHE_DIR: /cache/jit/vllm
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: /cache/jit/triton
      TORCH_EXTENSIONS_DIR: /cache/jit/torch_extensions
      TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR: /cache/jit/torchinductor
      FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE: /cache/jit/flashinfer
      XDG_CACHE_HOME: /cache/jit
      MODEL: ${MODEL:-/models/GLM-5.2-Int8Mix-NVFP4-REAP-594B}
      SERVED_MODEL_NAME: GLM-5.2
      PORT: '5000'
      TP_SIZE: '4'
      DCP_SIZE: ${DCP_SIZE:-4}
      MTP_TOKENS: ${MTP_TOKENS:-3}
      DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD: ${DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD:-probabilistic}
      ATTN_BACKEND: ${ATTN_BACKEND:-B12X_MLA_SPARSE}
      GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.96}
      MAX_MODEL_LEN: ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-460000}
      MAX_NUM_SEQS: ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-8}
      MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS: '4096'
      MAX_CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZE: ${MAX_CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZE:-32}
      GLM52_INDEX_TOPK_PATTERN: FFFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSSFSSS
    command:
    - /bin/bash
    - -lc
    - "set -euo pipefail\nunset NCCL_GRAPH_FILE NCCL_GRAPH_DUMP_FILE VLLM_B12X_MLA_EXTEND_MAX_CHUNKS\n\
      SPEC_ARGS=()\nif [ \"$${MTP_TOKENS}\" != \"0\" ]; then\n  SPEC_ARGS=(--speculative-config\
      \ \"{\\\"method\\\":\\\"mtp\\\",\\\"num_speculative_tokens\\\":$${MTP_TOKENS},\\\
      \"moe_backend\\\":\\\"b12x\\\",\\\"draft_sample_method\\\":\\\"$${DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD}\\\
      \"}\")\nfi\nexec vllm serve \"$${MODEL}\" \\\n  --served-model-name \"$${SERVED_MODEL_NAME}\"\
      \ \\\n  --host 0.0.0.0 \\\n  --port \"$${PORT}\" \\\n  --trust-remote-code \\\
      \n  --tensor-parallel-size \"$${TP_SIZE}\" \\\n  --decode-context-parallel-size\
      \ \"$${DCP_SIZE}\" \\\n  --dcp-comm-backend ag_rs \\\n  --dcp-kv-cache-interleave-size\
      \ 1 \\\n  --quantization compressed-tensors \\\n  --kv-cache-dtype fp8 \\\n\
      \  --attention-backend \"$${ATTN_BACKEND}\" \\\n  --moe-backend b12x \\\n  --load-format\
      \ fastsafetensors \\\n  -cc.pass_config.fuse_allreduce_rms=True \\\n  --gpu-memory-utilization\
      \ \"$${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION}\" \\\n  --max-model-len \"$${MAX_MODEL_LEN}\"\
      \ \\\n  --max-num-seqs \"$${MAX_NUM_SEQS}\" \\\n  --max-num-batched-tokens \"\
      $${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS}\" \\\n  --max-cudagraph-capture-size \"$${MAX_CUDAGRAPH_CAPTURE_SIZE}\"\
      \ \\\n  --async-scheduling \\\n  --enable-chunked-prefill \\\n  --enable-prefix-caching\
      \ \\\n  --enable-auto-tool-choice \\\n  --tool-call-parser glm47 \\\n  --reasoning-parser\
      \ glm45 \\\n  --default-chat-template-kwargs '{\"reasoning_effort\":\"high\"\
      }' \\\n  --hf-overrides \"{\\\"use_index_cache\\\":true,\\\"index_topk_pattern\\\
      \":\\\"$${GLM52_INDEX_TOPK_PATTERN}\\\"}\" \\\n  \"$${SPEC_ARGS[@]}\"\n"

app.title: puter
app.description: 🌐 The Internet Computer! Free, Open-Source, and Self-Hostable. - HeyPuter/puter
app.compose_content:
services:
  valkey:
    image: valkey/valkey:8-alpine
    container_name: puter-valkey
    restart: unless-stopped
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - "valkey-server \\\n  --port 6379 \\\n  --cluster-enabled yes \\\n  --cluster-config-file\
      \ /data/nodes.conf \\\n  --cluster-node-timeout 5000 \\\n  --cluster-require-full-coverage\
      \ no \\\n  --cluster-announce-ip valkey \\\n  --cluster-announce-port 6379 \\\
      \n  --cluster-announce-bus-port 16379 \\\n  --appendonly yes \\\n  --save \"\
      60 1\" &\nSERVER_PID=$$!\nuntil valkey-cli -p 6379 PING > /dev/null 2>&1; do\
      \ sleep 0.5; done\nif ! valkey-cli -p 6379 CLUSTER NODES | grep -q '0-16383';\
      \ then\n  valkey-cli -p 6379 CLUSTER ADDSLOTSRANGE 0 16383\nfi\nwait $$SERVER_PID\n"
    volumes:
    - ./puter/data/valkey:/data:z
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - valkey-cli -p 6379 cluster info | grep -q cluster_state:ok
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 10s
  mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: puter-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD:-root-change-me}
      MARIADB_DATABASE: ${MARIADB_DATABASE:-puter}
      MARIADB_USER: ${MARIADB_USER:-puter}
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${MARIADB_PASSWORD:-puter-change-me}
    volumes:
    - ./puter/data/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql:z
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - healthcheck.sh
      - --connect
      - --innodb_initialized
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 30s
  dynamo:
    image: amazon/dynamodb-local:latest
    container_name: puter-dynamo
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: 1000:1000
    working_dir: /home/dynamodblocal
    command:
    - -jar
    - DynamoDBLocal.jar
    - -sharedDb
    - -dbPath
    - /home/dynamodblocal/data
    volumes:
    - ./puter/data/dynamo:/home/dynamodblocal/data:z
  s3:
    image: rustfs/rustfs:latest
    container_name: puter-s3
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-puter}
      RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-puter-secret-change-me}
    volumes:
    - ./puter/data/s3:/data:z
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - wget -qO- --tries=1 --timeout=2 http://localhost:9000/health || exit 1
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20
      start_period: 5s
  s3-init:
    image: amazon/aws-cli:latest
    container_name: puter-s3-init
    depends_on:
      s3:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${S3_ACCESS_KEY:-puter}
      AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${S3_SECRET_KEY:-puter-secret-change-me}
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    - "set -e\nendpoint=http://s3:9000\nbucket=${S3_BUCKET:-puter-local}\nif aws --endpoint-url\
      \ \"$$endpoint\" s3api head-bucket --bucket \"$$bucket\" 2>/dev/null; then\n\
      \  echo \"bucket $$bucket already exists\"\nelse\n  echo \"creating bucket $$bucket\"\
      \n  aws --endpoint-url \"$$endpoint\" s3 mb \"s3://$$bucket\"\nfi\n"
    restart: 'no'
  ollama:
    profiles:
    - ai
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: puter-ollama
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - ./puter/data/ollama:/root/.ollama:z
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
  ollama-init:
    profiles:
    - ai
    image: ollama/ollama:latest
    container_name: puter-ollama-init
    depends_on:
      ollama:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      OLLAMA_HOST: http://ollama:11434
      OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL: ${OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL:-tinyllama}
    entrypoint:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    - 'set -e

      echo "[ollama-init] ensuring $${OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL}"

      ollama pull "$${OLLAMA_DEFAULT_MODEL}"

      echo "[ollama-init] done"

      '
    restart: 'no'
  puter:
    image: ghcr.io/heyputer/puter:main
    pull_policy: always
    container_name: puter
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      valkey:
        condition: service_healthy
      mariadb:
        condition: service_healthy
      dynamo:
        condition: service_started
      s3-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    expose:
    - '4100'
    environment:
      PUID: 1000
      PGID: 1000
    volumes:
    - ./puter/config:/etc/puter:z
    - ./puter/data/puter:/var/puter:z
    healthcheck:
      test: wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:4100/ || exit 1
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s
  caddy:
    image: caddy:2.11-alpine
    container_name: puter-caddy
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      puter:
        condition: service_started
    ports:
    - ${HTTP_PORT:-80}:80
    volumes:
    - ./caddy/Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro,z
    - ./puter/tls:/etc/caddy/tls:ro,z
    - ./puter/data/caddy:/data:z
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - wget -qO- --tries=1 --timeout=2 http://127.0.0.1:2019/config/ >/dev/null ||
        exit 1
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 5s

    - ASPNETCORE_HTTP_PORTS=9876

app.title: NetAlertX
app.description: Centralized network visibility and continuous asset discovery.  Monitor devices, detect change, and stay aware across distributed networks. - netalertx/NetAlertX
app.compose_content:
services:
  netalertx:
    network_mode: host
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: netalertx:latest
    container_name: netalertx
    read_only: true
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    cap_add:
    - NET_ADMIN
    - NET_RAW
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    - CHOWN
    - SETUID
    - SETGID
    sysctls:
      net.ipv4.conf.all.arp_ignore: 1
      net.ipv4.conf.all.arp_announce: 2
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: netalertx_data
      target: /data
      read_only: false
    - type: bind
      source: /etc/localtime
      target: /etc/localtime
      read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:mode=1700,uid=0,gid=0,rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,async,noatime,nodiratime
    environment:
      PUID: ${NETALERTX_UID:-20211}
      PGID: ${NETALERTX_GID:-20211}
      LISTEN_ADDR: ${LISTEN_ADDR:-0.0.0.0}
      PORT: ${PORT:-20211}
      GRAPHQL_PORT: ${GRAPHQL_PORT:-20212}
      ALWAYS_FRESH_INSTALL: ${ALWAYS_FRESH_INSTALL:-false}
      NETALERTX_DEBUG: ${NETALERTX_DEBUG:-0}
    mem_limit: 2048m
    mem_reservation: 1024m
    cpu_shares: 512
    pids_limit: 512
    logging:
      options:
        max-size: 10m
        max-file: '3'
    restart: unless-stopped
volumes:
  netalertx_data: null

      \ --bucket $${BUCKET_NAME} --endpoint-url $${ENDPOINT_URL} --notification-configuration\
      \ '{\"QueueConfigurations\":[{\"QueueArn\":\"arn:rustfs:sqs:us-east-1:primary:mqtt\"\
      ,\"Events\":[\"s3:ObjectCreated:*\",\"s3:ObjectRemoved:*\",\"s3:ObjectAccessed:*\"\
      ]}]}'\n\necho \"Buckets configured successfully.\"\n"
    depends_on:
      bucket:
        condition: service_healthy
      nats:
        condition: service_started
    networks:
    - safebucket-internal
    restart: 'no'
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 20m
        max-file: '1'
  database:
    container_name: database
    image: postgres:18
    volumes:
    - postgresql_data:/var/lib/postgresql
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 20m
        max-file: '1'
    shm_size: 128mb
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DATABASE__POSTGRES__USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DATABASE__POSTGRES__PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DATABASE__POSTGRES__NAME}
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - psql -U ${DATABASE__POSTGRES__USER} -d ${DATABASE__POSTGRES__NAME} -c 'SELECT
        1' || exit 1
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s
    networks:
    - safebucket-internal
  valkey:
    container_name: valkey
    image: valkey/valkey:9
    command:
    - valkey-server
    - --requirepass
    - ${CACHE__VALKEY__PASSWORD}
    networks:
    - safebucket-internal
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 20m
        max-file: '1'
    shm_size: 128mb
    volumes:
    - valkey_data:/data
  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit:v1.30
    container_name: mailpit
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 20m
        max-file: '1'
    volumes:
    - mail_data:/data
    ports:
    - 8025:8025
    - 1025:1025
    environment:
      MP_MAX_MESSAGES: 500
      MP_DATABASE: /data/mailpit.db
    networks:
    - safebucket-external
    - safebucket-internal
  nats:
    image: nats:2.14-alpine
    container_name: nats
    restart: unless-stopped
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 20m
        max-file: '1'
    command:
    - -c
    - /etc/nats/nats.conf
    ulimits:
      nofile:
        soft: 65536
        hard: 65536
    volumes:
    - nats_data:/data
    - ./config/nats.conf:/etc/nats/nats.conf:ro
    networks:
    - safebucket-internal
  loki:
    container_name: loki
    image: grafana/loki:3.7.6
    command: -config.file=/etc/loki/config.yaml
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: 20m
        max-file: '1'
    volumes:
    - ./config/loki.yaml:/etc/loki/config.yaml
    depends_on:
      bucket:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - loki
      - -health
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    networks:
    - safebucket-internal
networks:
  safebucket-external:
    driver: bridge
  safebucket-internal:

      args:

    image: trypost-app:dev
    ports:
    - ${APP_PORT:-8000}:80
    - ${REVERB_PORT:-8080}:8080
    - ${VITE_PORT:-5173}:5173
    environment:
      TRYPOST_DOCKER_BOOTSTRAP: '1'
      UID: ${UID:-1000}
      GID: ${GID:-1000}
      DB_HOST: pgsql
      DB_USERNAME: postgres
      REDIS_HOST: redis
    volumes:
    - .:/var/www/html
    - app-vendor:/var/www/html/vendor
    - app-node-modules:/var/www/html/node_modules
    extra_hosts:
    - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    depends_on:
      pgsql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -fsS
      - http://127.0.0.1/up
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 90s
  pgsql:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE:-trypost}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:-password}
    volumes:
    - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    - ./docker/postgres-init.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/10-create-test-db.sh:ro
    ports:
    - ${FORWARD_DB_PORT:-5432}:5432
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U ${DB_USERNAME:-postgres} -d ${DB_DATABASE:-trypost}
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: redis-server --appendonly yes
    volumes:
    - redisdata:/data
    ports:
    - ${FORWARD_REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - redis-cli
      - ping
      interval: 10s

    - ${FORWARD_MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT:-1025}:1025

app.title: headroom
app.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server. - headrooml...
app.compose_content:
services:
  headroom-proxy:
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        HEADROOM_BUILD_VERSION: ${HEADROOM_BUILD_VERSION:-source-build}
    command:
    - --host
    - 0.0.0.0
    environment:
    - HEADROOM_HOST=0.0.0.0
    - HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN=${HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN:?set HEADROOM_PROXY_TOKEN (see .env.example;
      e.g. openssl rand -hex 32)}
    - HOME=/home/nonroot
    - HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR=/home/nonroot/.headroom
    - HEADROOM_CONFIG_DIR=/home/nonroot/.headroom/config
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:8787:8787
    volumes:
    - headroom_workspace:/home/nonroot/.headroom
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - --fail
      - --silent
      - http://127.0.0.1:8787/readyz
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 20s
    depends_on:
    - qdrant
    - neo4j
  qdrant:
    image: qdrant/qdrant:v1.17.1
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:6333:6333
    - 127.0.0.1:6334:6334
    volumes:
    - qdrant_data:/qdrant/storage
    environment:
    - QDRANT__SERVICE__GRPC_PORT=6334
  neo4j:
    image: neo4j:5.26
    ports:
    - 127.0.0.1:7474:7474
    - 127.0.0.1:7687:7687
    volumes:
    - neo4j_data:/data
    environment:
    - NEO4J_AUTH=${NEO4J_AUTH:?set NEO4J_AUTH, e.g. neo4j/<strong-password>}
    - NEO4J_PLUGINS=["apoc"]
volumes:

  neo4j_data: null
